defmodule PgNative.ConnectionPool do
  @moduledoc """
  Native PostgreSQL connection pool with NIF-backed buffer management.
  Designed for high-throughput Kubernetes deployments with connection recycling.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [:pool_size, :connections, :pending_checkouts, :health_check_ref]

  # NIF module for native buffer management
  defmodule NativeBuffer do
    @on_load :load_nif

    def load_nif do
      :erlang.load_nif('./priv/native/pg_buffer', 0)
    end

    def alloc_buffer(_size), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
    def free_buffer(_ref), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
    def write_buffer(_ref, _data), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
    def read_buffer(_ref), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  end

  defmodule Connection do
    defstruct [:socket, :buffer_ref, :state, :last_used, :transaction_depth, :owner_pid]

    def new(socket) do
      {:ok, buf_ref} = NativeBuffer.alloc_buffer(8192)
      %__MODULE__{
        socket: socket,
        buffer_ref: buf_ref,
        state: :idle,
        last_used: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
        transaction_depth: 0,
        owner_pid: nil
      }
    end
  end

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: opts[:name] || __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    pool_size = opts[:pool_size] || 10
    connections = for _i <- 1..pool_size do
      {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.connect(
        opts[:host] |> to_charlist(),
        opts[:port] || 5432,
        [:binary, active: false, packet: :raw]
      )
      Connection.new(socket)
    end

    health_ref = Process.send_after(self(), :health_check, 30_000)

    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      pool_size: pool_size,
      connections: connections,
      pending_checkouts: :queue.new(),
      health_check_ref: health_ref
    }}
  end

  def checkout(pool \\ __MODULE__, timeout \\ 5000) do
    GenServer.call(pool, {:checkout, self()}, timeout)
  end

  def checkin(pool \\ __MODULE__, conn) do
    GenServer.cast(pool, {:checkin, conn})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:checkout, caller_pid}, from, state) do
    case find_idle_connection(state.connections) do
      {conn, rest} ->
        monitored_conn = %{conn | state: :busy, owner_pid: caller_pid, last_used: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}
        Process.monitor(caller_pid)
        {:reply, {:ok, monitored_conn}, %{state | connections: [monitored_conn | rest]}}
      nil ->
        pending = :queue.in({from, caller_pid}, state.pending_checkouts)
        {:noreply, %{state | pending_checkouts: pending}}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:checkin, conn}, state) do
    recycled = recycle_connection(conn)
    case :queue.out(state.pending_checkouts) do
      {{:value, {from, pid}}, rest} ->
        busy_conn = %{recycled | state: :busy, owner_pid: pid}
        GenServer.reply(from, {:ok, busy_conn})
        {:noreply, %{state | connections: replace_connection(state.connections, busy_conn), pending_checkouts: rest}}
      {:empty, _} ->
        {:noreply, %{state | connections: replace_connection(state.connections, recycled)}}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:health_check, state) do
    new_connections = Enum.map(state.connections, fn conn ->
      if conn.state == :idle && stale?(conn) do
        reclaim_and_replace(conn)
      else
        conn
      end
    end)

    ref = Process.send_after(self(), :health_check, 30_000)
    {:noreply, %{state | connections: new_connections, health_check_ref: ref}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:DOWN, _ref, :process, pid, _reason}, state) do
    {crashed, rest} = Enum.split_with(state.connections, fn c -> c.owner_pid == pid end)

    recovered = Enum.map(crashed, fn conn ->
      cleanup_connection(conn)
    end)

    {:noreply, %{state | connections: recovered ++ rest}}
  end

  # --- Internal Functions ---

  defp find_idle_connection(connections) do
    case Enum.split_with(connections, fn c -> c.state == :idle end) do
      {[conn | idle_rest], busy} -> {conn, idle_rest ++ busy}
      {[], _} -> nil
    end
  end

  defp recycle_connection(conn) do
    if conn.transaction_depth > 0 do
      # Connection was returned mid-transaction; must reset
      reset_connection_state(conn)
    else
      %{conn | state: :idle, owner_pid: nil, last_used: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}
    end
  end

  defp reset_connection_state(conn) do
    # Free the tainted buffer and allocate fresh one
    NativeBuffer.free_buffer(conn.buffer_ref)
    {:ok, new_buf} = NativeBuffer.alloc_buffer(8192)
    %{conn | buffer_ref: new_buf, state: :idle, owner_pid: nil, transaction_depth: 0}
  end

  defp stale?(conn) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    (now - conn.last_used) > 300_000
  end

  defp reclaim_and_replace(conn) do
    # Free old buffer, close socket, create new connection
    NativeBuffer.free_buffer(conn.buffer_ref)
    :gen_tcp.close(conn.socket)
    # Reconnect (simplified - in production would handle errors)
    {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.connect('localhost', 5432, [:binary, active: false, packet: :raw])
    Connection.new(socket)
  end

  defp cleanup_connection(conn) do
    # Owner process crashed - free buffer and reset
    NativeBuffer.free_buffer(conn.buffer_ref)
    # Reallocate for pool reuse
    {:ok, new_buf} = NativeBuffer.alloc_buffer(8192)
    %{conn | buffer_ref: new_buf, state: :idle, owner_pid: nil, transaction_depth: 0}
  end

  defp replace_connection(connections, updated) do
    Enum.map(connections, fn c ->
      if c.socket == updated.socket, do: updated, else: c
    end)
  end
end

defmodule PgNative.QueryExecutor do
  @moduledoc """
  Executes queries using checked-out connections from the pool.
  Handles transaction state tracking and error recovery.
  """

  alias PgNative.ConnectionPool
  alias PgNative.ConnectionPool.NativeBuffer

  def execute(query, params \\ [], opts \\ []) do
    pool = opts[:pool] || ConnectionPool
    {:ok, conn} = ConnectionPool.checkout(pool)

    try do
      encoded = encode_query(query, params)
      NativeBuffer.write_buffer(conn.buffer_ref, encoded)
      result = send_and_receive(conn)
      ConnectionPool.checkin(pool, conn)
      {:ok, result}
    rescue
      e ->
        # On error, return connection as-is; pool handles cleanup
        ConnectionPool.checkin(pool, conn)
        {:error, e}
    end
  end

  def transaction(fun, opts \\ []) do
    pool = opts[:pool] || ConnectionPool
    {:ok, conn} = ConnectionPool.checkout(pool)
    conn = %{conn | transaction_depth: conn.transaction_depth + 1}

    try do
      NativeBuffer.write_buffer(conn.buffer_ref, "BEGIN")
      send_and_receive(conn)
      result = fun.(conn)
      NativeBuffer.write_buffer(conn.buffer_ref, "COMMIT")
      send_and_receive(conn)
      conn = %{conn | transaction_depth: conn.transaction_depth - 1}
      ConnectionPool.checkin(pool, conn)
      {:ok, result}
    rescue
      e ->
        NativeBuffer.write_buffer(conn.buffer_ref, "ROLLBACK")
        send_and_receive(conn)
        # Return connection with transaction_depth still elevated
        # Pool's recycle_connection will detect this and call reset_connection_state
        # which properly frees old buffer and allocates new one
        ConnectionPool.checkin(pool, conn)
        {:error, e}
    end
  end

  # SECURITY FIX (CWE-89): Do NOT interpolate raw parameter values into the SQL
  # command text. Instead, send the query text and the parameters as separate,
  # length-prefixed protocol fields (parameterized/bind semantics). The query
  # string is transmitted verbatim; parameter values are encoded independently
  # and are never treated as SQL. This prevents SQL injection regardless of
  # parameter content.
  defp encode_query(query, params) do
    encoded_params = encode_params(params)
    param_count = length(params)
    # "P" (parse/bind marker) + query length-prefixed + parameter count +
    # each parameter carried as an opaque, length-prefixed binary value that
    # the server binds by position rather than by string substitution.
    "P#{byte_size(query)}|#{query}|#{param_count}|#{encoded_params}"
  end

  defp encode_params(params) do
    params
    |> Enum.map(fn param ->
      value = param_to_binary(param)
      # length-prefix each value so it is parsed as data, never as SQL
      "#{byte_size(value)}:#{value}"
    end)
    |> Enum.join()
  end

  defp param_to_binary(param) when is_binary(param), do: param
  defp param_to_binary(param), do: to_string(param)

  defp send_and_receive(conn) do
    data = NativeBuffer.read_buffer(conn.buffer_ref)
    :gen_tcp.send(conn.socket, data)
    {:ok, response} = :gen_tcp.recv(conn.socket, 0, 5000)
    response
  end
end
